title: Talk to Astor in iMessage
summary: Text Astor in iMessage about the stocks you actually own. Ask questions, get alerts when something matters, and follow up in the same thread.
body_markdown:
## What does Astor text you without being asked?


Astor follows every position you own and the earnings dates, filings and headlines that touch them, plus the themes you care about. When something crosses a line you care about, it texts you right away. When nothing matters, it stays quiet, which we think is as important as the alerts themselves.


Here’s a hypothetical. Say a company you own announces that its chief financial officer is leaving. Astor would text you what happened and why it matters for your position, given how much of it you hold, and what you could do about it, from doing nothing to reading the filing yourself. If you want to know more, you reply in the same thread and keep going, the way you would with a person.


Every alert links to the reasoning and sources behind it. That matters because the AI can be wrong, and you should be able to check its work before you act on anything. For more on how the watching works, read[stock alerts for news on stocks you own](https://www.astor.app/blog/stock-alerts-for-news-on-stocks-you-own) .
